subject: Private deploy - field ops handoff & launch validation window
messages:
From: Jared Lee <jared.lee@acme-robotics.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Private deploy - field ops handoff & validation window

Team —

We’re on track for the private deployment cutover this Friday (6/2). Per the preflight sync, Acme Ops will be on-site for networking and rack-level verification. We need Redwood on the bridge for the following windows:

- 06/02 08:00–10:00 PT: Network validation and ACL staging (low-traffic window)
- 06/02 10:30–12:00 PT: Smoke validation and service priming

Please confirm ownership for the runbook steps below and who will be the point on each:

1) L2/L3 neighbor checks and BGP session verification (EdgeNet + Acme)
2) VIP failover and NAT sanity (Redwood runtime ops)
3) KV cache warmup and prefix priming (runtime)
4) Observability hooks validation (tracing, token-level latency)

Attachments: network-diagram-v2.pdf (topology), initial runbook stub included (runbook-launch-validation.md). EdgeNet will be on call — eng@edgenet.io.

We would like to do a quick dry run Thursday afternoon (06/01) for items 1 and 2.

-Jared

Jared Lee
Platform Ops, Acme Robotics
(jared.lee@acme-robotics.com)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jared Lee <jared.lee@acme-robotics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deploy - field ops handoff & validation window

Thanks Jared — good outline.

I’ll take ownership of item 2 (VIP failover / NAT sanity) and item 3 (KV cache warmup). Monica, can you own the L2/L3 neighbor checks and coordinate EdgeNet presence for the dry run Thursday? Irene, please prep a short checklist for observability hooks (metrics + traces) that we can tick during smoke.

Quick asks from Redwood side:
- Can you attach the final ACL snapshot you want staged (we have the diagram but need actual ACL rules)?
- Are there any out-of-band maintenance windows at the datacenter for Friday morning?

I’ll put together the runbook play sequence and push to the shared Drive link.

-Sergio

Sergio Alvarez
Head of Private Deploys, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jared Lee <jared.lee@acme-robotics.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, EdgeNet Integrations <eng@edgenet.io>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy - field ops handoff & validation window

Sergio — I’ll own item 1.

Attached: runbook-launch-validation.md (v0.9), smoke-test-checklist.csv. I added a field-ops section with the exact packet captures we want to grab during neighbor bring-up and a sample BGP show output template for the ops team to paste into the ticket.

Draft run sequence (high-level):
- 08:00 PT: EdgeNet & Acme perform link and L2 adjacency checks (pcap capture)
- 08:20 PT: BGP session bring-up; collect BGP summary and neighbor table
- 08:45 PT: ACL staging on border (redwood to log-only for 10m)
- 09:00 PT: NAT/VIP failover smoke (Sergio)
- 10:00 PT: KV cache primer (Sergio), prefix warm-up (traffic mirroring)
- 10:30 PT: Full smoke: inject test traces, validate telemetry, run end-to-end prompt test

EdgeNet: please confirm someone can be onsite or on low-latency video for the 08:00–09:30 window. If not onsite, we need immediate access to the fabric controller API keys in the dry run so we can script the same checks.

(attachment: smoke-test-checklist.csv, type:text/csv)

I’ve also added a short rollback appendix — minimal things we can do to revert VIP and ACLs within 15 minutes.

-Monica

Monica Patel
Senior Deployment Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
From: Jared Lee <jared.lee@acme-robotics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: EdgeNet Integrations <eng@edgenet.io>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy - field ops handoff & validation window

Monica — got it, thanks for the detailed run sequence. EdgeNet will be onsite; I’ve copied their lead. ACL rules attached separately (edge-acl-final-06-01.txt). I can host the dry run tomorrow at 15:30 PT — short 30m slot to test BGP bring-up and the log-only ACL staging.

Also confirming no datacenter maintenance windows Friday morning.

-Jared

(attachment: edge-acl-final-06-01.txt)
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy - field ops handoff & validation window

ACK — I’ll publish the observability checklist and a short runbook snippet to validate token-level latency, span drops, and error-rate thresholds. Will include post-smoke validation scripts and the log locations. I’ll be on the bridge Friday and for the Thursday dry run.

-Irene
